data_fields.name: unit_marker
data_fields.donor_constant: map name starting with '*' starts a new unit (drops all zone saves)

data_fields.name: deathmatch_skips_restore
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: deathmatch server never restores a zone snapshot

data_fields.name: clients_saved_as_bodies
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: player entities are not written into the zone snapshot

best_idea: Save a zone's live entities when the player leaves, and overlay them on the zone's fresh baseline when it is entered again, so kills stay dead, while all saves are dropped at a unit boundary.
decision_why: Keep the save-on-exit, build-baseline-then-overlay and unit-wipe shape with the server writing a typed snapshot; reject the binary edict dump and the abort-on-bad-file load, which do not fit server-verified kills or the one ledger.
acceptance: Server test: a player kills 3 of 5 mobs in zone A and leaves; on re-entry the 3 stay dead and the 2 living mobs are where they were; the player is placed at a spawn point, not in an old body; a deathmatch-style zone ignores its snapshot and respawns its baseline; a map name starting with * drops all saved zones.
